name: Hail – Calgary and central Alberta

geo.extent: Southern and central Alberta foothills and plains

description: Calgary lies in one of Canada's most hail-prone areas. The August 2024 hailstorm caused $2.8 billion in insured losses, the costliest hailstorm in Canadian history and Canada's costliest weather event of 2024.

practical_implications: Roof, siding and vehicle damage; insurance premiums and deductibles

sources.title: Canada's 10 most impactful weather stories of 2024

verification.notes: Event facts quoted or paraphrased from the cited official pages on 2026-10-30. Exposure and implications are agent-04 interpretation.

limitations: The "most hail-prone" statement is agent-04 interpretation; hail-day counts are in the Calgary clim record where ECCC publishes them. Past events show exposure; they are not a prediction for any particular year. Exposure varies street by street – check municipal and provincial hazard maps for a specific property.
